Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Ms. Swati Verma, Advocate on behalf of Mr. 
Mukesh Rawat, Advocate for the petitioner. 
Mr. Ajay Singh Bisht, Addl. C.S.C. for the 
State of Uttarakhand. 
Mr. Sunil Chandra, Advocate for private 
respondents in WPMS No. 2268 of 2017. 
In Writ Petition No. 54 of 2018, the sole 
petitioner has met with the sad demise on 26th
January, 2021. Hence, the proposed heirs of the 
deceased/petitioner, had filed the Substitution 
Application No. 4229 of 2021, along with Delay 
Condonation Application No. 4230 of 2021, 
explaining the delay of 158 days’, which has 
chanced in filing the Substitution Application. 
Being satisfied with the reasons given in the 
Delay Condonation Application, coupled with the 
fact that, it is not being seriously opposed by the 
respondents, the delay condonation application 
would stand allowed. 
The delay in filing Substitution Application 
would stand condoned.  Accordingly, the Substitution Application too 
would stand allowed. 
The learned counsel for the petitioner is 
directed to carry out the necessary amendment in 
the cause title of the Writ Petition, by bringing the 
heirs of the deceased/petitioner on record. 
In WPMS No. 2268 of 2017, the private 
respondents have filed the Impleadment 
Application No. 14343 of 2019, to which, the 
learned counsel for the petitioner, prays for and is 
granted two weeks’ time to file objection. 
Place the copy of this order in the connected 
Writ Petition. 
List thereafter. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 18.10.2021
Shiv

14.06.2022 WPMS No. 54 of 2018
With
WPMS No. 2268 of 2017
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Mukesh Rawat, Advocate, for the 
petitioner.
Mr. T.S. Phartiyal, Addl. CSC, for the 
State.
Mr. Mahavir Singh Tyagi, Senior 
Advocate, assisted by Ms. Namita, Advocate, for 
the respondent(s).
These are the two connected matters. In 
one of the writ petitions, being WPMS No.
2268/2017, an Impleadment Application 
(CLMA/14343/2019), has been filed by as many as 
eight persons who have sought themselves to be 
impleaded in the writ petition. The learned counsel 
for the petitioner was granted time to file objection 
to the said impleadment application which he could 
not do so within the time prescribed. As such, he 
makes a statement at the Bar that the Impleadment 
Application may be allowed.
Accordingly, the Impleadment 
Application would stand allowed.
The learned counsel for the petitioner of 
WPMS No. 2268/2017, would carry out the 
necessary amendment in the cause title of the writ 
petition by impleading the proposed applicants to 
the impleadment application as a party respondents.
List these writ petitions as soon as the 
amendment is carried, and during the intervening 
period, if so advised, the learned counsel for the 
petitioner may file his rejoinder affidavit to the 
counter affidavit filed by respondent Nos. 3 to 5, 
which has already been filed on record. 
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 14.06.2022 Mahinder/
